an8.70:1.1: 77 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.70:1.2: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
an8.70:1.3: vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
an8.70:1.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā nisīdanaṃ ādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
an8.70:2.1: athakho bhagavā yena pāvālacetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi
an8.70:2.2: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
an8.70:3.1: ramaṇīyā ānanda vesālī ramaṇīyaṃ udenacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtakacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sattambacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ pāvālacetiyaṃ
an8.70:3.2: yassa kassaci ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā ākaṅkhamāno so ānanda kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā
an8.70:3.3: tathāgatassa kho ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā ākaṅkhamāno ānanda tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vāti.
an8.70:3.4: evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kariyamāne oḷārike obhāse kariyamāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ
an8.70:3.6: tiṭṭhatu bhante bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu bhante sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti yathātaṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
an8.70:4.2: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
an8.70:4.3: ramaṇīyā ānanda vesālī ramaṇīyaṃ udenacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtakacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sattambacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadacetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ pāvālacetiyaṃ
an8.70:4.4: yassa kassaci ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā
an8.70:4.5: …pe… ākaṅkhamāno ānanda tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vāti
an8.70:4.6: evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kariyamāne oḷārike obhāse kariyamāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ
an8.70:4.8: tiṭṭhatu bhante bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu bhante sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti yathātaṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
an8.70:5.2: gaccha tvaṃ ānanda yassa dāni kālaṃ maññasīti.
an8.70:5.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā bhagavato avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
an8.70:5.4: athakho māro pāpimā acirapakkante āyasmante ānande bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.70:6.1: parinibbātu dāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato parinibbānakālo dāni bhante bhagavato
an8.70:6.2: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā
an8.70:6.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantīti
an8.70:6.4: etarahi bhante bhikkhū bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti
an8.70:7.1: parinibbātu dāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato parinibbānakālo dāni bhante bhagavato
an8.70:7.2: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā
an8.70:7.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti …pe…
an8.70:7.4: yāva me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti …pe…
an8.70:7.5: yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantīti
an8.70:7.6: etarahi bhante upāsikā bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti
an8.70:8.1: parinibbātudāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato parinibbānakālodāni bhante bhagavato
an8.70:8.2: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā
an8.70:8.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhañceva bhavissati phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitanti
an8.70:8.4: etarahi bhante bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhañceva phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ
an8.70:9.1: parinibbātu dāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato parinibbānakālo dāni bhante bhagavatoti.
an8.70:9.2: appossuko tvaṃ pāpima hohi naciraṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati
an8.70:9.3: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatīti
an8.70:10.1: athakho bhagavā pāvālacetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajji
an8.70:10.2: ossajjite bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahā bhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu
an8.70:10.3: athakho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
an8.70:12.3: sumahā vatāyaṃ bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu
an8.70:12.4: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyāti
an8.70:13.1: athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.70:13.3: sumahā vatāyaṃ bhante bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu
an8.70:13.4: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyāti.
an8.70:14.1: aṭṭhime ānanda hetū aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya
an8.70:14.3: yaṃ ānanda mahāpaṭhavī udake patiṭṭhitā udakaṃ vāte patiṭṭhitaṃ vāto ākāsaṭṭho hoti so ānanda samayo yaṃ mahāvātā vāyanti mahāvātā vāyantā udakaṃ kampenti udakaṃ kampitaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampeti
an8.70:14.4: ayaṃ ānanda paṭhamo hetu paṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:15.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā iddhimā cetovasippatto devatā vā mahiddhikā mahānubhāvā tassa parittā paṭhavīsaññā bhāvitā hoti appamāṇā āposaññā so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampeti saṃkampeti sampakampeti
an8.70:15.2: ayaṃ ānanda dutiyo hetu dutiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:16.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātu kucchiṃ okkamati tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati
an8.70:16.2: ayaṃ ānanda tatiyo hetu tatiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:17.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā bodhisatto sato sampajāno mātu kucchismā nikkhamati tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati
an8.70:17.2: ayaṃ ānanda catuttho hetu catuttho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:18.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati
an8.70:18.2: ayaṃ ānanda pañcamo hetu pañcamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:19.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavatteti tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati
an8.70:19.2: ayaṃ ānanda chaṭṭho hetu chaṭṭho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:20.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā tathāgato sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajjati tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati
an8.70:20.2: ayaṃ ānanda sattamo hetu sattamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:21.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda yadā tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati
an8.70:21.2: ayaṃ ānanda aṭṭhamo hetu aṭṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:21.3: ime kho ānanda aṭṭha hetū aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyāti.
